notes: «أبي رحمة الله» is the compiler's father, named only by relation; the blessing is not part of the surface
The Imam «أبي عبد الله» sits inside the chain after «عن», so he stays a narrator; the Imam's words are the saying
Sudair's own question («قلت: جعلت فداك») is part of the saying, not a route
